Eugene O’Neill, The Hairy Ape.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/eugene-oneill/the-hairy-ape

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Eugene O’Neill, the author, died 1953.

First publication of the text used: 1922 (SE colophon: 'The Hairy Ape was published in 1922 by Eugene O’Neill.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the Standard Ebooks rights statement says the text is in the US public domain, and the text was first published in 1922, before 1931, so it is public domain there.
- Country of origin: the facts do not say in which country the text was first published. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each has a term of life + 70 years or less for these deaths, and the United States rule above applies there. The last to die did so in 1953, so the text is public domain in each of them by 1 January 2024.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
